title: Exodus Chapter 26 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Exodus chapter 26 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Exodus Chapter 26 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Exodus Chapter 26.

questions.question: What materials were used to make the ten curtains of the tabernacle?
options: Fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet
Goats' hair and rams' skins
Shittim wood and gold
Badgers' skins and brass
questions.correctAnswer: Fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:1 states that the ten curtains were made of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet.

questions.question: What were the dimensions of one of the ten curtains?
options: 28 cubits long and 4 cubits wide
30 cubits long and 4 cubits wide
10 cubits long and 1.5 cubits wide
20 cubits long and 5 cubits wide
questions.correctAnswer: 28 cubits long and 4 cubits wide
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:2 specifies that each curtain was 28 cubits in length and 4 cubits in breadth.

questions.question: How were the ten curtains arranged?
options: Five curtains coupled together, and the other five coupled together
All ten curtains coupled separately
Three curtains coupled, then seven separately
Two sets of four curtains coupled with two separate curtains
questions.correctAnswer: Five curtains coupled together, and the other five coupled together
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:3 states that five curtains were coupled one to another, and the other five curtains were coupled one to another.

questions.question: What color were the loops made on the edges of the curtains for coupling?
options: Blue
Gold
Scarlet
Purple
questions.correctAnswer: Blue
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:4 commands that loops of blue were to be made on the edges of the curtains for coupling.

questions.question: How many loops were to be made on each curtain edge for coupling?
options: Fifty
Twenty
One hundred
Ten
questions.correctAnswer: Fifty
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:5 directs that fifty loops were to be made on one curtain and fifty on the edge of the other curtain for coupling.

questions.question: What were the curtains coupled together with?
options: Fifty taches of gold
Copper nails
Silver hooks
Brass rings
questions.correctAnswer: Fifty taches of gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:6 states that fifty taches of gold were to be made to couple the curtains together.

questions.question: What material were the eleven curtains for the covering upon the tabernacle made of?
options: Goats' hair
Fine twined linen
Rams' skins dyed red
Badgers' skins
questions.correctAnswer: Goats' hair
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:7 commands making eleven curtains of goats' hair as a covering upon the tabernacle.

questions.question: What were the dimensions of the curtains made of goats' hair?
options: 30 cubits long and 4 cubits wide
28 cubits long and 4 cubits wide
10 cubits long and 1.5 cubits wide
20 cubits long and 5 cubits wide
questions.correctAnswer: 30 cubits long and 4 cubits wide
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:8 specifies that each goats' hair curtain was 30 cubits in length and 4 cubits in breadth.

questions.question: How were the eleven goats' hair curtains arranged?
options: Five curtains by themselves, six curtains by themselves, doubling the sixth in front
All eleven curtains coupled together
Six curtains first, then five curtains coupled
Ten curtains coupled and one separate
questions.correctAnswer: Five curtains by themselves, six curtains by themselves, doubling the sixth in front
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:9 instructs to couple five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves, doubling the sixth curtain in the forefront.

questions.question: How many taches of brass were to be made to couple the goats' hair curtains?
options: Fifty
Twenty
Seventy
One hundred
questions.correctAnswer: Fifty
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:11 commands making fifty taches of brass to couple the goats' hair curtains together.

questions.question: What was to be done with the half curtain that remained of the tent curtains?
options: It shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle
It shall be discarded
It shall be used for the door
It shall be folded inside the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: It shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:12 states that the half curtain that remains shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

questions.question: How much was the curtain to hang over on each side of the tabernacle for covering?
options: One cubit on each side
Two cubits on each side
Half a cubit on each side
Three cubits on each side
questions.correctAnswer: One cubit on each side
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:13 specifies that a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other side shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.

questions.question: True or False: The ten curtains of the tabernacle were made with cherubims of cunning work.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:1 describes the curtains as having cherubims of cunning work.

questions.question: True or False: The eleven curtains of goats' hair were all of different sizes.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:8 states that the eleven curtains of goats' hair were all of one measure.

questions.question: True or False: Fifty loops were made on the edge of one curtain and only forty on the other for coupling.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:5 specifies that fifty loops were made on each curtain edge to couple them together.

medium.title: Exodus Chapter 26 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Exodus Chapter 26 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What materials are specified for making the covering of the tabernacle in Exodus 26:14?
options: Rams' skins dyed red and badgers' skins
Fine twined linen and scarlet
Goats' hair and shittim wood
Blue and purple cloth
questions.correctAnswer: Rams' skins dyed red and badgers' skins
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:14 clearly states that the covering for the tent shall be made of rams' skins dyed red and a covering above of badgers' skins, specifying the outer layers of protection for the tabernacle.

questions.question: According to Exodus 26:15-16, what are the dimensions of each board for the tabernacle?
options: Ten cubits long and a cubit and a half broad
Twenty cubits long and two cubits broad
Eight cubits long and four cubits broad
Five cubits long and one cubit broad
questions.correctAnswer: Ten cubits long and a cubit and a half broad
questions.explanation: Verses 15 and 16 specify that the boards are made of shittim wood and each board is ten cubits in length and one and a half cubits in breadth.

questions.question: How are the boards of the tabernacle designed to fit together, as described in Exodus 26:17?
options: Each board has two tenons set one against another
Each board has hooks and loops of blue
The boards are tied with goats' hair curtains
The boards are overlaid with gold and connected by rings
questions.correctAnswer: Each board has two tenons set one against another
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:17 explains that each board has two tenons that are set one against another to connect the boards securely for the tabernacle's structure.

questions.question: How many boards and silver sockets are required for the south side of the tabernacle according to Exodus 26:18-19?
options: Twenty boards and forty silver sockets
Ten boards and twenty silver sockets
Thirty boards and sixty silver sockets
Fifteen boards and thirty silver sockets
questions.correctAnswer: Twenty boards and forty silver sockets
questions.explanation: Verses 18 and 19 specify twenty boards for the south side and that forty silver sockets are made for those boards, with two sockets per board's two tenons.

questions.question: True or False: The north side of the tabernacle has the same number of boards and silver sockets as the south side.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:20-21 states that the north side also has twenty boards and forty silver sockets, mirroring the south side's structure.

questions.question: How many boards are to be made for the west side and corners of the tabernacle in Exodus 26:22-25?
options: Six boards for the west side and two corner boards, totaling eight boards
Ten boards for the west side and no corner boards
Four boards total, including corners
Eight boards for the west side and four corner boards
questions.correctAnswer: Six boards for the west side and two corner boards, totaling eight boards
questions.explanation: Verses 22-25 describe six boards for the west side and two additional boards for the two corners, making eight boards with sixteen silver sockets total.

questions.question: What is the significance of coupling the two corner boards together above and below as described in Exodus 26:24?
options: It secures the corner boards to form a stable tabernacle corner
It decorates the boards with gold rings
It connects the boards to the curtains
It prepares the boards for the gold overlay
questions.correctAnswer: It secures the corner boards to form a stable tabernacle corner
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:24 explains that the corner boards are coupled together below and above by one ring, ensuring that both corners are stable and connected properly.

questions.question: According to Exodus 26:26-28, how many bars of shittim wood are made and what is special about the middle bar?
options: Fifteen bars total; the middle bar reaches from end to end
Ten bars total; the middle bar is shorter than the others
Five bars total; the middle bar is made of gold
Twenty bars total; the middle bar is doubled
questions.correctAnswer: Fifteen bars total; the middle bar reaches from end to end
questions.explanation: Verses 26-28 instruct to make five bars for each side and five for the west side, totaling fifteen, with the middle bar extending the entire length of the boards.

questions.question: What does Exodus 26:29 say about the finishing of the boards and bars?
options: They shall be overlaid with gold and have gold rings for the bars
They shall be painted blue and purple
They shall be wrapped in goats' hair
They shall be covered with fine twined linen
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be overlaid with gold and have gold rings for the bars
questions.explanation: Verse 29 explains that the boards and bars are overlaid with gold and the rings for holding the bars are also made of gold, indicating the value and sanctity of the tabernacle.

questions.question: True or False: Exodus 26:30 commands that the tabernacle be erected exactly according to the pattern shown on the mountain.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:30 instructs to rear up the tabernacle exactly according to the fashion shown on the mount, emphasizing obedience to God's revealed design.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the vail made according to Exodus 26:31-33?
options: To divide the holy place from the most holy place and to hang the ark of the testimony within
To cover the entire tabernacle and keep out the weather
To serve as a curtain for the door of the tent
To decorate the outer covering with cherubims
questions.correctAnswer: To divide the holy place from the most holy place and to hang the ark of the testimony within
questions.explanation: Verses 31-33 describe the vail as a dividing curtain between the holy place and the most holy place where the ark of the testimony is placed, serving a sacred separating function.

questions.question: Based on Exodus 26:34-35, where is the mercy seat placed and what items are set outside the vail?
options: The mercy seat is on the ark in the most holy place; the table and candlestick are outside the vail
The mercy seat is outside the tabernacle; the lampstand is inside the most holy place
The mercy seat is on the table; the candlestick is beside the ark
The mercy seat and table are both inside the most holy place
questions.correctAnswer: The mercy seat is on the ark in the most holy place; the table and candlestick are outside the vail
questions.explanation: Verses 34-35 indicate the mercy seat is placed on the ark within the most holy place, while the table and candlestick are set outside the vail in the holy place.

questions.question: What materials and workmanship are described for the hanging of the door of the tent in Exodus 26:36-37?
options: Blue, purple, scarlet, fine twined linen with needlework and five gold-overlaid pillars
Rams' skins dyed red with brass pillars
Goats' hair curtains with silver sockets
Badgers' skins with bronze hooks
questions.correctAnswer: Blue, purple, scarlet, fine twined linen with needlework and five gold-overlaid pillars
questions.explanation: Verses 36-37 describe the door hanging as made of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework, supported by five shittim wood pillars overlaid with gold and brass sockets.

questions.question: According to Exodus 26:19 and 26:21, what practical principle can be drawn about the design of the tabernacle's boards and sockets?
options: Every board requires two silver sockets to secure its tenons, emphasizing stability through faithful obedience
Boards can share sockets, showing flexibility in God's design
Only the south side boards need sockets, indicating partial protection
The sockets are decorative and not functional
questions.correctAnswer: Every board requires two silver sockets to secure its tenons, emphasizing stability through faithful obedience
questions.explanation: Verses 19 and 21 show that each board has two tenons secured by two silver sockets, reflecting the necessity of precise obedience to God's instructions for a stable tabernacle.

questions.question: A believer struggles with understanding how to trust God's instructions in practical matters. Based on Exodus 26:14-30, what biblical truth about obedience and faith can be applied?
options: Faithfulness in following God's detailed instructions leads to His presence and blessing
God only cares about spiritual matters, not physical details
Human creativity should replace strict adherence to divine instruction
Obedience is optional when the task seems difficult
questions.correctAnswer: Faithfulness in following God's detailed instructions leads to His presence and blessing
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:14-30 shows God's detailed design for the tabernacle and commands obedience to the pattern shown on the mount (v30), teaching that faithfulness in obeying God’s directions brings His presence.

hard.title: Exodus Chapter 26 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Exodus Chapter 26.

questions.question: How many bars of shittim wood are to be made for the boards on the west side of the tabernacle?
options: Five
Six
Ten
Twelve
questions.correctAnswer: Five
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:27 states that five bars are to be made for the boards on the side of the tabernacle westward.

questions.question: What is the special feature of the middle bar among the boards of the tabernacle?
options: It is made of gold
It reaches from end to end
It is twice as thick
It is decorated with cherubims
questions.correctAnswer: It reaches from end to end
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:28 explains that the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

questions.question: According to Exodus 26, how are the boards and bars to be finished?
options: Painted with blue dye
Overlayed with silver
Overlayed with gold
Left as raw wood
questions.correctAnswer: Overlayed with gold
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:29 commands overlaying the boards and bars with gold, and making rings of gold for the bars.

questions.question: What instruction is given for setting up the tabernacle in Exodus 26:30?
options: Build it with bricks
Rear it up according to the fashion seen on the mount
Construct it with stone pillars
Make it according to the pattern of Solomon's temple
questions.correctAnswer: Rear it up according to the fashion seen on the mount
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:30 states that the tabernacle shall be reared up according to the fashion shown on the mount.

questions.question: What materials are used to make the vail separating the holy place and the most holy?
options: Blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen with cherubims
Goats' hair and rams' skins
Shittim wood and gold
Badgers' skins and brass
questions.correctAnswer: Blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen with cherubims
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:31 describes the vail as made of blue, purple, scarlet, fine twined linen, with cherubims of cunning work.

questions.question: On what are the vail's four pillars made, and how are they adorned?
options: Acacia wood overlaid with silver
Shittim wood overlaid with gold with gold hooks
Cedar wood with brass hooks
Olive wood with iron hooks
questions.correctAnswer: Shittim wood overlaid with gold with gold hooks
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:32 specifies four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold and hooks of gold upon silver sockets.

questions.question: What is the purpose of hanging up the vail under the taches according to Exodus 26?
options: To divide between the holy place and the most holy
To protect the ark from dust
To decorate the tabernacle
To hide the priest's garments
questions.correctAnswer: To divide between the holy place and the most holy
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:33 states the vail divides between the holy place and the most holy, allowing access to the ark of testimony within.

questions.question: Where is the mercy seat placed according to Exodus 26?
options: Upon the table in the holy place
Upon the altar of incense
Upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place
Outside the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: Upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:34 directs that the mercy seat is to be put upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

questions.question: Which items are placed outside the vail in the tabernacle?
options: The ark of testimony and mercy seat
The table and the candlestick
The altar of burnt offering and laver
The five bars and boards
questions.correctAnswer: The table and the candlestick
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:35 mentions setting the table without the vail and the candlestick opposite the table inside the tabernacle.

questions.question: What colors and materials are used for the hanging of the door of the tent?
options: Blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen wrought with needlework
Goats' hair and rams' skins
Shittim wood and brass
Badgers' skins and silver
questions.correctAnswer: Blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen wrought with needlework
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:36 specifies the hanging for the door is made from blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen with needlework.

questions.question: What materials and number of pillars are used for the hanging of the door of the tent?
options: Five pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold and five brass sockets
Four pillars of cedar wood with silver hooks and four silver sockets
Six pillars of acacia wood with brass hooks and six brass sockets
Seven pillars of olive wood with iron hooks and seven iron sockets
questions.correctAnswer: Five pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold and five brass sockets
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:37 states the hanging has five pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold, gold hooks, and five brass sockets.

questions.question: True or False: The middle bar of the tabernacle boards is described as extending only halfway across the boards.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:28 clearly states the middle bar shall reach from end to end, not only halfway.

questions.question: True or False: The vail described in Exodus 26 foreshadows the separation between God and man that will be removed through Christ, as seen in the New Testament (Hebrews 10:20).
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:31-33 describes the vail separating the holy and most holy places, which Hebrews 10:20 reveals is a foreshadowing of Christ's flesh that allows direct access to God.

questions.question: Which other biblical passage echoes the theme of the 'mercy seat' found in Exodus 26:34 as a symbol of God's presence and atonement?
options: Leviticus 16:2
Genesis 1:1
Psalm 23:1
Matthew 5:9
questions.correctAnswer: Leviticus 16:2
questions.explanation: Leviticus 16:2 discusses the presence of God above the mercy seat on the ark, reinforcing the theme from Exodus 26:34.

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the word 'taches' mentioned in Exodus 26:6 and 11, used to couple the curtains?
options: Pins or clasps
Threads or cords
Hooks or handles
Nails or stakes
questions.correctAnswer: Pins or clasps
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word translated as 'taches' refers to pins or clasps used to fasten the curtains together as described in Exodus 26:6 and 26:11.

theological.title: Exodus Chapter 26 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Exodus Chapter 26 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What materials and colors are specified for the ten curtains of the tabernacle in Exodus 26:1, and what is the symbolic significance of the cherubims?
options: Fine twined linen, blue, purple, scarlet; cherubims symbolize divine presence and protection
Goats' hair, blue, purple, scarlet; cherubims represent human sinfulness
Shittim wood, fine twined linen, gold; cherubims depict angelic worship
Badgers' skins, scarlet, purple, blue; cherubims signify God's judgment
questions.correctAnswer: Fine twined linen, blue, purple, scarlet; cherubims symbolize divine presence and protection
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:1 specifies the curtains are made of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet with cherubims of cunning work. Cherubims represent God's presence and guardianship over the holy place (see also Ezekiel 1:5-11).

questions.question: According to Exodus 26:15-16, what are the dimensions and material of the boards for the tabernacle, and what does this indicate about God's holiness?
options: Shittim wood, 10 cubits long and 1.5 cubits wide; indicating strength and durability appropriate for God's dwelling
Acacia wood, 8 cubits long and 2 cubits wide; showing God's flexibility
Cedar wood, 12 cubits long and 1 cubit wide; symbolizing divine beauty
Olive wood, 9 cubits long and 1.5 cubits wide; reflecting peace
questions.correctAnswer: Shittim wood, 10 cubits long and 1.5 cubits wide; indicating strength and durability appropriate for God's dwelling
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:15-16 says boards of shittim wood are 10 cubits by 1.5 cubits. Shittim wood is known for durability, symbolizing God's unchanging holiness and the enduring nature of His presence.

questions.question: How does the design of the tabernacle curtains and their coupling with loops and taches (Exodus 26:4-6) reflect theological truths about the unity of God's people?
options: The loops and taches coupling the curtains signify the inseparable unity and interconnectedness of God's covenant community
The curtains remain separate to symbolize individualism in worship
The use of gold taches indicates material wealth as the foundation of unity
The curtains’ coupling represents the division between different tribes
questions.correctAnswer: The loops and taches coupling the curtains signify the inseparable unity and interconnectedness of God's covenant community
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:4-6 describes loops and gold taches coupling five curtains to five others, making one tabernacle. This reflects the unity and inseparability of God's people as one body (cf. Ephesians 4:3-6).

questions.question: What is the theological significance of the vail described in Exodus 26:31-33, especially regarding access to the Most Holy Place?
options: It symbolizes the separation between God and man due to sin, with the vail dividing the Holy Place and Most Holy Place
It represents God's indifference towards humanity
It indicates the openness of the sanctuary to all people
It is a purely decorative element with no deeper meaning
questions.correctAnswer: It symbolizes the separation between God and man due to sin, with the vail dividing the Holy Place and Most Holy Place
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:31-33 explains the vail divides the Holy and Most Holy Place, symbolizing the barrier sin creates between God and humanity (cf. Hebrews 9:3-7).

questions.question: How do the materials used for the outer coverings of the tabernacle (rams' skins dyed red and badgers' skins) in Exodus 26:14 reflect aspects of Christ's redemptive work?
options: The red-dyed skins symbolize Christ's atoning blood; the badgers' skins represent protection and durability
They merely signify wealth with no redemptive meaning
The skins indicate human effort in salvation
They represent the fallenness of creation unrelated to redemption
questions.correctAnswer: The red-dyed skins symbolize Christ's atoning blood; the badgers' skins represent protection and durability
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:14 mentions rams' skins dyed red and badgers' skins as coverings. The red dye points to Christ's blood sacrifice, and the durable skins point to God's protective covering over His people (cf. Isaiah 53:5).

questions.question: What doctrine is illustrated by the detailed instructions for the construction of the tabernacle boards, bars, sockets, and overlay of gold in Exodus 26:25-29?
options: The doctrine of God's holiness and the necessity of reverent worship
The doctrine of predestination
The doctrine of original sin
The doctrine of justification by faith alone
questions.correctAnswer: The doctrine of God's holiness and the necessity of reverent worship
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:25-29 describes the precise construction and gold overlay, emphasizing God's holiness and the call for reverent, careful worship (cf. Leviticus 10:3).

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the detailed construction instructions in Exodus 26 are merely archaic rituals with no spiritual relevance. What does Exodus 26:30-33 actually teach about the purpose of these details?
options: They reveal God's desire to dwell among His people and foreshadow Christ as the true meeting place between God and man
They are outdated rituals with no continuing significance
They teach that God is distant and inaccessible
They emphasize human achievement over divine grace
questions.correctAnswer: They reveal God's desire to dwell among His people and foreshadow Christ as the true meeting place between God and man
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:30-33 instructs to build the tabernacle as shown on the mount, with the vail dividing the holy from the most holy, where the ark is placed. This prefigures Christ, the true mediator and God's dwelling among humanity (cf. John 1:14; Hebrews 9:11-12).

questions.question: How do Exodus 26:7-11's descriptions of the goats' hair curtains and their coupling reinforce the theological theme of covering and atonement?
options: The goats' hair coverings symbolize sin's removal and God's provision of atonement
They represent the uncleanliness of the people
They are merely functional and lack theological meaning
They signify human effort to earn salvation
questions.correctAnswer: The goats' hair coverings symbolize sin's removal and God's provision of atonement
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:7-11 details goats' hair curtains coupled with brass taches, symbolizing atonement as goats were used for sin offerings (cf. Leviticus 16). The coverings illustrate God's provision for sin's covering.

questions.question: What attribute of God is highlighted by the precise measurement and order in the construction of the tabernacle's boards and sockets as described in Exodus 26:18-21?
options: God's orderliness and sovereignty over creation
God's wrath
God's mercy exclusively
God's hiddenness
questions.correctAnswer: God's orderliness and sovereignty over creation
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:18-21 specifies twenty boards on south and north sides with forty silver sockets, reflecting God's orderly nature and sovereign design in His dwelling place (cf. 1 Corinthians 14:40).

questions.question: Combining Exodus 26:36-37 and 26:32, what do the materials and design of the door hanging and vail teach about access to God and the nature of mediation?
options: Access to God is mediated through divine appointment and costly materials symbolizing holiness and grace
Access is unrestricted and casual
The materials indicate human merit as the basis of access
The door and vail are mere decorations without spiritual significance
questions.correctAnswer: Access to God is mediated through divine appointment and costly materials symbolizing holiness and grace
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:36-37 describes the door hanging of fine linen and gold-overlaid pillars; 26:32 describes the vail hung on gold pillars. This symbolizes that access to God is mediated by holiness and divine provision (cf. Hebrews 10:19-22).

questions.question: In Exodus 26:22-25, the corner boards are coupled with rings and are supported by silver sockets. What theological truth can be drawn about Christ from this structural detail?
options: Christ is the corner stone who holds the church together with strength and unity
Christ is a minor figure in the tabernacle
Christ is represented as a purely ornamental aspect
The corner boards symbolize human leadership exclusively
questions.correctAnswer: Christ is the corner stone who holds the church together with strength and unity
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:22-25 describes two corner boards coupled together, symbolizing Christ as the cornerstone uniting the church (cf. Ephesians 2:20; 1 Peter 2:6).

questions.question: What doctrinal teaching about sanctification is implied by the overlaying of the tabernacle boards and bars with gold in Exodus 26:29?
options: Believers are to be set apart and purified, reflecting God's holiness
Sanctification is irrelevant to worship
Gold signifies human pride in sanctification
The overlay is only for physical protection
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are to be set apart and purified, reflecting God's holiness
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:29 commands overlaying with gold, symbolizing sanctification—being set apart and purified as God is holy (cf. 1 Peter 1:15-16).

questions.question: How does the instruction in Exodus 26:12-13 about the remnant curtains hanging over the sides of the tabernacle illustrate God's protective attribute?
options: They provide covering and protection, symbolizing God's providential care over His people
They show God's indifference to detail
They demonstrate human self-sufficiency
They indicate God's judgment
questions.correctAnswer: They provide covering and protection, symbolizing God's providential care over His people
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:12-13 describes the half curtain hanging over the tabernacle sides for covering, illustrating God's protection and care (cf. Psalm 91:4).

questions.question: What combined theological insight do Exodus 26:26-27 and Exodus 26:28 convey regarding the strength and unity of the tabernacle structure?
options: The bars spanning end to end symbolize Christ's sustaining power holding the church together in unity
The bars indicate human weakness
They represent the fragility of God's presence
They suggest division among God's people
questions.correctAnswer: The bars spanning end to end symbolize Christ's sustaining power holding the church together in unity
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:26-27 commands five bars per side, and 26:28 says the middle bar reaches end to end, typifying Christ's sustaining power uniting the body of believers (cf. Colossians 1:17).

questions.question: How does the construction of the tabernacle as commanded in Exodus 26:30 relate to the broader biblical narrative of divine revelation and covenant?
options: It shows obedience to God's revealed pattern, emphasizing covenant faithfulness and divine order
It suggests human innovation in worship
It rejects God's sovereignty
It demonstrates God's silence
questions.correctAnswer: It shows obedience to God's revealed pattern, emphasizing covenant faithfulness and divine order
questions.explanation: Exodus 26:30 commands building the tabernacle according to the pattern shown on the mount, highlighting God's self-revelation and the importance of covenant obedience (cf. Hebrews 8:5).
